source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Suppression
ranks: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Corruption
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Curse of Weakness
ranks: Increases the effect of your Curse of Weakness by 6%.
Increases the effect of your Curse of Weakness by 13%.
Increases the effect of your Curse of Weakness by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Life Tap
ranks: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by 0%.

talents.name: Soul Siphon
ranks: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

talents.name: Improved Bane of Agony
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 2%.

talents.name: Fel Concentration
ranks: Gives your Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Amplify Curse
ranks: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Bane of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Grim Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by 20%.

talents.name: Nightfall
ranks: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

talents.name: Siphon Life
ranks: Transfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Curse of Exhaustion
ranks: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

talents.name: Improved Curse of Exhaustion
ranks: Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by 5%.
Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by 10%.
Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by 15%.
Increases the speed reduction of your Curse of Exhaustion by 20%.

talents.name: Shadow Mastery
ranks: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Healthstone
ranks: Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by 10%.
Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by 20%.

talents.name: Improved Imp
ranks: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

talents.name: Demonic Embrace
ranks: Increases your total Stamina by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Health Funnel
ranks: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

talents.name: Improved Voidwalker
ranks: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, and Suffering spells by 30%.

talents.name: Fel Vitality
ranks: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Sayaad
ranks: Increases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%.

talents.name: Fel Domination
ranks: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

talents.name: Master Summoner
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

talents.name: Unholy Power
ranks: Increases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Subjugate Demon
ranks: Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 2% and reduces the resist chance by 2%.
Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 4% and reduces the resist chance by 4%.
Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 6% and reduces the resist chance by 6%.
Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 8% and reduces the resist chance by 8%.
Reduces the Attack Speed and Casting Speed penalty of your Subjugate Demon spell by 10% and reduces the resist chance by 10%.

talents.name: Demonic Sacrifice
ranks: When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hr. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

talents.name: Improved Firestone
ranks: Increases the bonus Fire damage from Firestones and the Firestone effect by 15%.
Increases the bonus Fire damage from Firestones and the Firestone effect by 30%.

talents.name: Master Demonologist
ranks: Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active. Imp - Increases Fire damage done by 10%. Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by 10%. Succubus/Incubus - Increases Shadow damage done by 10%. Felhunter - Reduces Magic damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Soul Link
ranks: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

talents.name: Improved Spellstone
ranks: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your Spellstone by 15%.
Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your Spellstone by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
ranks: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 0% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Cataclysm
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

talents.name: Bane
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt, Immolate, and Incinerate spells by 0.5 sec and your Soul Fire spell by 2 sec.

talents.name: Aftermath
ranks: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Firebolt
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 0.5 sec.
Reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 1 sec.

talents.name: Improved Lash of Pain
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain spell by 3 sec.
Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain spell by 6 sec.

talents.name: Devastation
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

talents.name: Shadowburn
ranks: Instantly blasts the target for 62 to 70 Shadow damage. If a non-trivial target dies within 8 sec of being hit with Shadowburn, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

talents.name: Intensity
ranks: Gives your Destruction spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Destructive Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by 20%.

talents.name: Agonizing Flames
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by 10% and the damage done by all your Destruction spells by 10%.

talents.name: Apocalypse
ranks: Your non-periodic critical strikes with your Fire spells increase your Shadow damage done by 10% for 3 sec, and your non-periodic critical strikes with your Shadow spells increase your Fire damage done by 10% for 3 sec.
Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

talents.name: Improved Immolate
ranks: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 5%.
Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 10%.
Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 15%.
Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 20%.
Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 25%.

talents.name: Ruin
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells by 100%.

talents.name: Emberstorm
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 10% and reduces the cast time of your Searing Pain spell by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Conflagrate
ranks: Ignites a target that is already afflicted by your Immolate spell, dealing 128 to 164 Fire damage and consuming your Immolate effect.
